segments.thig13.4:1.3: Tuvaṃ divā ca ratto ca, atīva paritappasi.
segments.thig13.4:2.3: Vāseṭṭhi kena vaṇṇena, na bāḷhaṃ paritappasi”.
segments.thig13.4:4.3: Na socāmi na rodāmi, na cāpi paritappayiṃ”.
segments.thig13.4:5.3: Kassa tvaṃ dhammamaññāya, giraṃ [thiraṃ (sī.)] bhāsasi edisiṃ”.
segments.thig13.4:7.1: “Tassa brahme [brāhmaṇa (sī. syā.)] arahato, dhammaṃ sutvā nirūpadhiṃ;
segments.thig13.4:8.3: Appeva maṃ so bhagavā, sabbadukkhā pamocaye”.
segments.thig13.4:11.3: Sujāto tīhi rattīhi, tisso vijjā aphassayi.
segments.thig13.4:12.5: Sujāto tīhi rattīhi, tisso vijjā aphassayi’”.
segments.thig13.4:13.5: Sujāto tīhi rattīhi, tisso vijjā aphassayi”.
segments.thig13.4:14.3: Tevijjaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sutvā [ñatvā (sī.)], puṇṇapattaṃ dadāmi te”.
segments.thig13.4:16.3: Pitā pabbajito tuyhaṃ, bhuñja bhogāni sundari;
segments.thig13.4:17.1: “Hatthī gavassaṃ maṇikuṇḍalañca, rammaṃ cimaṃ gahavibhavaṃ pahāya;
segments.thig13.4:18.1: “So te ijjhatu saṅkappo, yaṃ tvaṃ patthesi sundarī;
segments.thig13.4:19.3: Pubbenivāsaṃ jānāmi, yattha me vusitaṃ pure.
segments.thig13.4:20.3: Tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
segments.thig13.4:24.3: Sāvikā te mahāvīra, pāde vandati sundarī”.
segments.thig13.4:25.1: “Tuvaṃ buddho tuvaṃ satthā, tuyhaṃ dhītāmhi brāhmaṇa;
segments.thig13.4:26.1: “Tassā te svāgataṃ bhadde, tato [atho (ka.)] te adurāgataṃ;
segments.thig13.4:26.3: Evañhi dantā āyanti, satthu pādāni vandikā;

lines: Kuto pana āgatā, kattha ca āgatā, kīdisā cāyaṃ sundarīti āsaṅkantānaṃ āsaṅkaṃ nivattetuṃ “bārāṇasito”ti gāthaṃ vatvā tattha “sāvikā cā”ti vuttamatthaṃ pākaṭataraṃ kātuṃ “tuvaṃ buddho”ti gāthamāha.

Tassattho – imasmiṃ sadevake loke tuvameveko sabbaññubuddho, diṭṭhadhammikasamparāyikaparamatthehi yathārahaṃ anusāsanato tuvaṃ me satthā, ahañca khīṇāsavabrāhmaṇī bhagavā tuyhaṃ ure vāyāma janitābhijātitāya orasā, mukhato pavattadhammaghosena sāsanassa ca mukhabhūtena ariyamaggena jātattā mukhato jātā, niṭṭhitapariññātādikaraṇīyatāya katakiccā, sabbaso āsavānaṃ khepitattā anāsavāti.
Athassā satthā āgamanaṃ abhinandanto “tassā te svāgatan”ti gāthamāha.
Tassattho – yā tvaṃ mayā adhigataṃ dhammaṃ yāthāvato adhigacchi.
Tassā te, bhadde sundari, idha mama santike āgataṃ āgamanaṃ suāgataṃ.
Tato eva taṃ adurāgataṃ na durāgataṃ hoti.

Yasmā evañhi dantā āyantīti, yathā tvaṃ sundari, evañhi uttamena ariyamaggadamathena dantā tato eva sabbadhi vītarāgā, sabbesaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ samucchinnattā visaṃyuttā katakiccā anāsavā satthu pādānaṃ vandikā āgacchanti, tasmā tassā te svāgataṃ adurāgatanti yojanā.
